content: Nokoy man to ogkaamungan to pagbubuyow now dow pagkuntrahan? Duon sikan ogkapuun to kahakog no ogsamuk to ginhawa now.

Ko kona now ogkapudut to ogkaliyagan now, dajun kow oghimatoy. Ko kona now ogkadawat to ogkaibogan now, dajun kow ogpagbuyow dow ogpagkuntra. Di iyan man kona now igkaangkon to sikan ogkaibogan now su kona kow man ogpamuju to Diyus.
Aw inggad ogpamuju kow kandin, kona kow ogbogajan su madoot man to tuud now. Iyan igpamuju now agun no matuman sikan kahakog now.

Angod kow to ogpanghonay, su anoy Diyus podom to payabihon now, iyan hinuun pigpayabi now to kinalibutanon no mgo hinang dow mgo botang. Wada now buwa kamaani no to otow no oghinang to sikan nakapagkuntra on to Diyus?
Basi nailing to boot now no wada pues to sikan sinuyat no kagi to Diyus no pig-iling, “To ispiritu no imbotang to Diyus kani ita meyduon ogtubu no kahakog.”
Di to tabang to Diyus ita yabow pad to sikan kahakog ta. Su to Kasuyatan to Diyus mig-iling,
Kaling paobos kow duon to Diyus. Atuhi si Satanas, aw ogyaguy sikandin.
Padani kow to Diyus, aw ogpadani sikandin iyu. Sikiyu no mgo makasasaya, ojowi now on to sae. Sikiyu no mgo paling-paling to pagtuu, tibuyusa to ginhawa now duon to Diyus.
Ikaguul yagboy to mangkadoot no hinang now aw itiyahu. To pagngisi now ilisi to pagtiyahu tongod to sikow now to sikan no mgo hinang.
Ipaobos to kaugalingon now duon to Diyus, aw ogbajawon kow din.

Mgo suun, sigkon kow on to ogpasasawajay. Su to otow no ogsawoy dow oghukum to duma din, kibali pigtamay din to mgo balaod to Diyus. Na, ko tamajon now sikan mgo balaod to Diyus, kona now ogkatuman sikan, nasi no ogpayabawan now.
To Diyus iyan migbogoy to sikan mgo balaod, aw sikandin da to meyduon gahom to paghukum. Wada yain ogpakayuwas dow ogpakakastigu. Na sikuna, hintawa ka man no ogpatugu oghukum to duma?
Sikiyu no og-iling no og-andiya kow kuntoon ubin kasem to songo yunsud, paminogi a. Ogplanu kow no diya kow og-ugpa sed to songo tuig su ognigusyu agun madogi to ogkaganansya.
Di wada kow kamaan dow nokoy to og-abut iyu kasem, su to kinabuhi now angod to gabun no madali da ogboyongon.
Iyan podom madojow ko umiling kow, “Ko itugut to Ginuu no habaon pad to kinabuhi ta, seini to oghinangon ta.”
Di sikiyu, garbusu kow su ighinambug now to oghinangon now to umaabut no panahon. Madoot sikan.
Kaling to otow no namaan no mey madojow no oghinangon di kona din ogtumanon, nakasae sikandin.
